_comment: Baseline snapshot of per-role pass-rates. Recorded by `node tests/evals/run-acceptance.mjs --record-baseline` (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and a clean tree). ci-compare.mjs fails a PR if any role drops more than regression_threshold_pp below its pass_rate here. IMPORTANT: a role whose pass_rate is null is BOOTSTRAPPING and does NOT block — while every entry is null, the only hard gate on a prompt change is the snapshot --check. Note the gate also needs the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY secret present in CI; without it ci-compare.mjs skips every role and exits 0. See .github/workflows/evals.yml and README.md.
